meta.title: AgentBridge — Supabase MCP Tool Execution & Safety Decision Workflow
meta.subtitle: Read-Only Classification, PolicyEngine Risk Boundary, MCP Execution & Activity Auditing
meta.description: Decision workflow governing tool execution through the Supabase MCP Connector. Illustrates read-only classification (get_, list_, read_, search_, describe_, explain_), client-side gating under read_only=True, PolicyEngine risk evaluation, Streamable HTTP JSON-RPC dispatch, error normalization, and ActivityStore auditing.

states.label: Verify Connected State
states.description: Checks if connector is connected and MCP session is in READY state.

states.label: Is Connected?
states.description: Branch on connection state. If not connected, reject with ConnectorNotConnectedError.

states.label: Record Audit Start
states.description: Records tool call start in ActivityStore with sanitized arguments and request_id.

states.label: Is Read-Only Tool?
states.description: Evaluates tool prefix (get_, list_, read_, search_, describe_, explain_, sql_select) or tool annotation read_only=True.

states.label: Connector configured with read_only=True?
states.description: Checks if connector enforces strict read-only mode.

states.label:
Deny Execution
(ConnectorPermissionError)
states.description: Hard rejection: mutating or unknown tool cannot be executed when read_only=True.

states.label: PolicyEngine Risk Evaluation
states.description: Evaluates deterministic precedence: CRITICAL invariants > Session Grants > Persistent Policy > Default Risk.

states.label: Authorized by Policy?
states.description: Checks if PolicyEngine allowed execution (or auto-allowed LOW risk tool_read).

states.label: Raise ConnectorPermissionError
states.description: Execution blocked by PolicyEngine policy violation or missing user confirmation.

states.label: MCPClient.call_tool()
states.description: Dispatches tools/call over Streamable HTTP with injected Bearer token.

states.label: Invocation Success?
states.description: Inspects JSON-RPC result for protocol errors, HTTP 401/403, or tool errors.

states.label: Update ActivityStore (COMPLETED)
states.description: Records completion latency, status, and scrubbed result payload.

states.label: Return ConnectorResult(success=True)
states.description: Returns sanitized structured output to caller.

states.label: Update ActivityStore (FAILED)
states.description: Records error code and scrubbed error message.
